priority_update.source_ref: User: 重量实在满足不了，优先以完成需求为主，重量可以妥协
priority_update.rule: Task completion first; mass may exceed 3 kg after comparison. The 3 kg allocation is a reference, not a rejection gate. No new user-approved maximum mass; 30-40 cm and all tasks remain unchanged.

metadata_convention: Every JSON pointer is its parameter_id; units are encoded in keys. Rows inherit version/date/status and source_type=assumed, source_ref=deliverables/system_reset_v14.md, uncertainty=not_quantified unless explicitly overridden. These are allocations and sensitivity inputs, not measured values or statistical confidence intervals.
scope: Complete dressed robot including battery, sensors, wiring, grippers and contingency; excludes carried water bottle, offboard host and optional staff. All user tasks remain active.

dimensions.measurement_rule: Upright relaxed arms, dressed, no staff. Width/depth here are design targets, not comparable directly to old forward-arm pose depth. Task swept volume must be reported separately.
dimensions.note: Lengths close only for an ideal straight-leg dimension chain, not an assembled posture. Axis offsets, knee flexion, ankle shell and crown clearance must be modeled before acceptance. Ankle-foot mass is a subset of the allocations, never an extra line. No ideal zero-offset joint pack is approved.

candidates.note: 12 leg + 6 shoulder/elbow XM; 4 wrist + 2 neck + 2 gripper XC. The eight small actuators are not load-approved. Short dual-supported joints; no adoption of old heavy ankle.
AK at bilateral hip pitch/knee/ankle pitch; same nonmotor allowance is optimistic because mixed rails, cooling and supports may need more mass. No jump capability implied.
Mass requirements for future search only. No claimed motor exists with all required torque-speed-thermal-impact capabilities at these masses.

screening.note: Independent idealized sensitivity cases, not fullbody dynamics. COM/friction/energy densities, durations, mass distribution and contact allocation are assumed. Landing results are displacement-averaged forces, not measured peaks; jump is vertical only, never a flip proof.
